status: planning artifact, not a qualified maintenance schedule

sources.use: failure mode/effect thinking; no robot-specific interval inferred
only if this product is selected: follow its assembly, substrate and cure instructions

entries.failureMode: fastener movement or bracket deformation after contact
entries.evidence: original bracket envelopes only; attachment/load capacity unresolved
entries.trigger: visible damage, looseness, changed witness marks or unusual impact
entries.inspection: isolate energy; inspect backing, fasteners and bracket geometry; witness marks show movement, not retained preload
entries.test: qualified attachment procedure and measured load test still required
entries.repair: replace damaged components; apply specified joint procedure, not blanket threadlocker reapplication

entries.cadRef: intake inner telescoping arm / telescoping sleeve reserve
entries.failureMode: binding, lost position or retention failure
entries.evidence: prescribed kinematic telescope; actuator/compliance not modeled
entries.trigger: position disagreement, jam, anomalous commanded-versus-measured behavior
entries.inspection: isolate energy and support gravity-loaded mechanism before checking guides, bearings and connections
entries.test: sweep with measured new/worn pieces, position fault injection and power-loss retention tests
entries.repair: follow component-specific procedure; retest full sweep and calibration
entries.operatorResponse: stop acquisition; report fault; no automatic claim of safe holding

entries.failureMode: unequal or insufficient speed, wear or support looseness
entries.evidence: equal-roller powered simulation; actual wear, imbalance and unequal-wheel dynamics unvalidated
entries.trigger: speed/freshness disagreement, recurring jam, visible wear, repeatable vibration change
entries.inspection: isolate energy; inspect rollers, shaft support and retention; compare against recorded baseline
entries.test: log each commanded/measured RPM and timestamp, voltage, current, exit observation and piece condition; determine thresholds experimentally
entries.repair: replace/adjust per selected components and retest both capture and release
entries.operatorResponse: inhibit release; optional degraded planning requires operator request and verified reduced operating envelope

entries.effect: power interruption, exposed conductor or shifted mass
entries.evidence: reserve volume only, no engineered retention
entries.trigger: impact, visible movement, damaged insulation or unexpected power behavior
entries.inspection: isolate power; inspect mechanical restraint and electrical connections

diagnostics.vibration: An anomaly prompts inspection, not a diagnosis. Order analysis requires suitable mounted sensors, bandwidth/sample rate, RPM reference and controlled baseline.
diagnostics.intervals: No fixed fatigue life, replacement interval or per-match threadlocker schedule established.
